tasks.title: Verify build and full test suite
tasks.description: Run the full test suite with `bun test` and verify all tests pass. Run `bun run build` and verify the compiled binary builds successfully. Run `ralph --version` to smoke test the binary. If any tests fail or the build breaks, fix the issues. Check that the new [a]uto-review option appears in the help/menu output if applicable.
tasks.notes: All 680 tests pass, bun run build succeeds (29 modules, 134ms compile), ralph --version returns 0.1.0. No issues found.
